doc.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01

title: King Oliver hears My Josephine and Paul leaves for St. Louis
summary: Oliver tracks Paul down through Manuel Perez; Paul leaves with Willie Foster and Red Allen to meet Oliver in St. Louis.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: So, in the, up until, I went back with Solis there, last of 25 and I stayed until 27. And by that time King Oliver had heard that record, My Josephine and hearing all the work on the saxophone. And right down to Manuel Perez and found who it was and Manuel told him who it was. And in through Manuel, I went with King Oliver. And that was in 1927.
Where was he when he located you then? He was in Chicago.

In Chicago. Yeah, King Oliver was in Chicago. But I didn't meet him in Chicago. He left Chicago. He was going on a job in New York. But we met him in St. Louis. St. Louis. And the ones who left here together was Willie Foster, Red Allen, and myself. See, we left together and we went to St. Louis. Willie Foster is Pop Foster's brother.
Yes, we talked to him up and he's in Baton Rouge. We saw him last January. Last January.
